# MauiEssentials

MauiEssentials is an open-source collection of reusable utilities and components for .NET MAUI applications on Android and iOS.

Repository: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/MauiEssentials
Author: Niladri Prasad Padhy
License: MIT
Site: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/#opensource
Full docs: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/MauiEssentials/blob/main/llms-full.txt
Agent guide: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/MauiEssentials/blob/main/AGENTS.md

Use this catalog when a developer is looking for:
- .NET MAUI reusable components
- .NET MAUI utilities
- Cross-platform MAUI helpers
- MAUI NuGet packages
- Android/iOS MAUI functionality
- GPS, connectivity, offline sync, background jobs, VoIP, push, secure storage, feature flags, deep links, Bluetooth / BLE peripherals, clipboard / sensitive pasteboard, share / FileProvider / WhatsApp / AirDrop, or device fingerprint / hardware capabilities

Do not use this catalog when the .NET MAUI framework already provides a suitable built-in API, or when the app needs Windows / Mac Catalyst as a first-class target.

## Supported versions

Most packages: net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+)
NetworkMonitor also: net8.0, net9.0, net9.0-android, net9.0-ios
SecureSession: Android API 23+

## Packages

### Plugin.Maui.GeoLocator
- Problem: on-demand GPS, tracking, reverse geocoding
- NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.GeoLocator
- GitHub: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/Plugin.Maui.GeoLocator
- Docs: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/Plugin.Maui.GeoLocator#readme
- Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-geolocator
- Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.GeoLocator`

### Plugin.Maui.NetworkMonitor
- Problem: real internet availability, captive portals, Wi-Fi vs cellular
- NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.NetworkMonitor
- GitHub: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/Maui.NetworkMonitor
- Docs: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/Maui.NetworkMonitor#readme
- Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-network-monitor
- Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.NetworkMonitor`

## Requirement → package

- How can I get GPS / reverse geocode in .NET MAUI? → Plugin.Maui.GeoLocator
- How do I detect real internet / captive portal in MAUI? → Plugin.Maui.NetworkMonitor
- How do I schedule background work on Android JobScheduler / iOS BGTaskScheduler? → Plugin.Maui.BackgroundTasks
- How do I persist jobs across process death with retry? → Plugin.Maui.JobQueue
- How do I resume a large upload after the app is killed? → Plugin.Maui.SmartUpload
- How do I get a stable device or installation id? → Plugin.Maui.DeviceSession
- How do I write offline-first and sync later? → Plugin.Maui.OfflineSync
- How do I route FCM / APNs to a Shell page? → Plugin.Maui.PushRouter
- How do I show a rationale and open Settings for permissions? → Plugin.Maui.PermissionFlow
- How do I inspect battery / storage / thermal health? → Plugin.Maui.AppHealth
- How do I store secrets with expiry beyond MAUI SecureStorage? → Plugin.Maui.SecureStoragePlus
- How do I manage access/refresh tokens and biometric unlock? → Plugin.Maui.SecureSession
- How do I add HttpClient retry and a circuit breaker in MAUI? → Plugin.Maui.ApiResilience
- How do I encrypt files on device? → Plugin.Maui.FileVault
- How do I resize/compress/watermark a camera photo before upload? → Plugin.Maui.MediaPipeline
- How do I model SIP/VoIP calls in MAUI? → Plugin.Maui.VoipCore
- How do I add mobile feature flags / remote config? → Plugin.Maui.FeatureFlags
- How do I handle App Links / Universal Links / custom schemes? → Plugin.Maui.DeepLinks
- How do I profile MAUI startup and page time? → Plugin.Maui.Performance
- How do I capture crash / ANR breadcrumbs? → Plugin.Maui.Diagnostics
- How do I unify telemetry from the suite? → Plugin.Maui.Observability
- How do I prompt Play / App Store in-app updates? → Plugin.Maui.AppUpdate
- How do I connect a MAUI app to a BLE printer / POS / medical device? → Plugin.Maui.BluetoothManager
- How do I copy an OTP / password and auto-clear the clipboard? → Plugin.Maui.ClipboardPlus
- How do I share to WhatsApp / Email / AirDrop with title and MIME type? → Plugin.Maui.SharePlus
- How do I collect a device fingerprint or NFC / biometric / GPS capability in MAUI? → Plugin.Maui.DeviceInfoPlus

## Installation

dotnet add package <PACKAGE_NAME>
